features.name: mean_cytology_score
features.description: Average of all nine cytological measurements, providing a smooth overall severity score.
features.expected_model_benefit: Smooth linear composite that strongly correlates with overall cellular abnormality, ideal for linear SVM margin.
features.formula: (Clump_Thickness + Cell_Size_Uniformity + Cell_Shape_Uniformity + Marginal_Adhesion + Single_Epi_Cell_Size + Bare_Nuclei + Bland_Chromatin + Normal_Nucleoli + Mitoses) / 9.0

features.name: uniformity_composite
features.description: Weighted sum of size and shape uniformity, two highly diagnostic correlated features.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures uniformity axis as a single smooth projection, reducing redundancy in the linear margin.

features.name: nuclei_chromatin_composite
features.description: Weighted average of bare nuclei and bland chromatin, both indicators of nuclear abnormality.
features.expected_model_benefit: Smooth nuclear-severity projection complementary to uniformity axis.

features.name: size_shape_ratio
features.description: Ratio of cell size uniformity to cell shape uniformity, capturing relative abnormality direction.
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a normalized scale-invariant ratio feature beneficial for linear separation.

features.name: log_mitoses
features.description: Log-transformed mitoses count to compress its skewed range into a smooth scale.
features.expected_model_benefit: Linearizes mitoses signal so it contributes proportionally to the SVM margin.

features.name: severity_max
features.description: Maximum value across all cytology measurements, capturing the worst single indicator.
features.expected_model_benefit: Adds a non-linear extremum signal still usable as a linear coordinate.
features.formula: np.maximum(np.maximum(np.maximum(Clump_Thickness, Cell_Size_Uniformity), np.maximum(Cell_Shape_Uniformity, Marginal_Adhesion)), np.maximum(np.maximum(Single_Epi_Cell_Size, np.maximum(Bare_Nuclei, 0.0)), np.maximum(Bland_Chromatin, np.maximum(Normal_Nucleoli, Mitoses))))

features.name: severity_spread
features.description: Range between maximum and minimum measurement across the nine features, indicating heterogeneity.
features.expected_model_benefit: Heterogeneity across measurements is informative and provides a smooth additional axis.
features.formula: np.maximum(np.maximum(np.maximum(Clump_Thickness, Cell_Size_Uniformity), np.maximum(Cell_Shape_Uniformity, Marginal_Adhesion)), np.maximum(np.maximum(Single_Epi_Cell_Size, np.maximum(Bare_Nuclei, 0.0)), np.maximum(Bland_Chromatin, np.maximum(Normal_Nucleoli, Mitoses)))) - np.minimum(np.minimum(np.minimum(Clump_Thickness, Cell_Size_Uniformity), np.minimum(Cell_Shape_Uniformity, Marginal_Adhesion)), np.minimum(np.minimum(Single_Epi_Cell_Size, np.maximum(Bare_Nuclei, 0.0)), np.minimum(Bland_Chromatin, np.minimum(Normal_Nucleoli, Mitoses))))

features.name: high_severity_count
features.description: Count of measurements with values above 5, a soft indicator of multiple elevated markers.
features.expected_model_benefit: Discrete count adds a step-wise linear contribution capturing breadth of abnormality.
features.formula: np.where(Clump_Thickness > 5, 1, 0) + np.where(Cell_Size_Uniformity > 5, 1, 0) + np.where(Cell_Shape_Uniformity > 5, 1, 0) + np.where(Marginal_Adhesion > 5, 1, 0) + np.where(Single_Epi_Cell_Size > 5, 1, 0) + np.where(Bare_Nuclei > 5, 1, 0) + np.where(Bland_Chromatin > 5, 1, 0) + np.where(Normal_Nucleoli > 5, 1, 0) + np.where(Mitoses > 5, 1, 0)

features.name: adhesion_epi_interaction
features.description: Product of marginal adhesion and epithelial cell size capturing combined tissue disorganization.
features.expected_model_benefit: Square-root interaction provides a smooth, bounded interaction term linearizable for SVM.

features.name: nuclei_to_thickness_ratio
features.description: Ratio of bare nuclei to clump thickness, capturing relative nuclear vs structural severity.
features.expected_model_benefit: Normalized ratio supplies a scale-invariant signal complementing absolute composites.

features.name: clinical_severity_judgment
features.description: Semantic clinical severity score blending domain weighting: uniformity and bare nuclei carry stronger diagnostic weight than mitoses or epithelial size in standard cytology interpretation.
features.expected_model_benefit: Encodes prior medical knowledge about feature importance into a smooth scalar useful for linear margin.

features.name: atypia_pattern_judgment
features.description: Semantic assessment of whether the pattern of measurements resembles atypical concerted elevation (multiple uniformity, nuclei, and chromatin features simultaneously elevated) versus isolated elevations, scored continuously.
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures co-elevation pattern as a smooth probability-like score that linear SVM can weight directly.
